spans.s: म्ना (i. e. मन् + आ), i. 1, मन,

. To fix in the memory by frequent repetition.
 2. To remember, to praise (ved.).
 --With the prep. आ आ, To repeat frequently, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 30. आम्नाता, Recorded, Pañc. i. d. 408.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To prescribe, Utt.

.
 --Cf. μιμνήσκω, μνῆμα, μνάομαι; Lat. meminisse.
 --Cf. मन्.
